subject: general
question: Two numbers X and Y are such that the sum of 3% of X and 2% of Y is two - third of the sum of 2% of X and 6% of Y. The ratio of three times of X to two times of Y is :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cancel out the % sign and solve directly:

⇒ 3(3X + 2Y) = 2(2X + 6Y)

⇒ 9X + 6Y = 4X + 12Y

⇒ 5X = 6Y ⇒ X/Y = 6/5

⇒ Required Ratio = (3 × 6) : (2 × 5) = 18 : 10 = 9 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of 3% of X and 2% of Y = ²/₃ × (Sum of 2% of X and 6% of Y)

 Ratio Visualization
 
 3X
 
 18 units
 
 2Y
 
 10 units
 
 Ratio = 18 : 10 = 9 : 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ ³/₁₀₀ × X + ²/₁₀₀ × Y = ²/₃ × (²/₁₀₀ × X + ⁶/₁₀₀ × Y)

⇒ 3X + 2Y = ²/₃ × (2X + 6Y)

⇒ 3 × (3X + 2Y) = 2 × (2X + 6Y)

⇒ 9X + 6Y = 4X + 12Y

⇒ 9X − 4X = 12Y − 6Y

⇒ 5X = 6Y

⇒ X/Y = ⁶/₅

We need to find the ratio of 3X to 2Y:

⇒ ³X/₂Y = ³/₂ × X/Y

⇒ ³X/₂Y = ³/₂ × ⁶/₅

⇒ ³X/₂Y = ¹⁸/₁₀ = ⁹/₅

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio & Proportion

Four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion if a:b = c:d. The product of means equals the product of extremes (b × c = a × d).

Componendo & Dividendo

If a/b = c/d, then by the rule of componendo and dividendo, (a+b)/(a−b) = (c+d)/(c−d).

Duplicate & Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is a²:b², and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a:√b.
